title: Policies
description: Rule sets governing which tool actions are allowed, denied, or require approval.

suggest.dialogTitle: Generate a draft policy with AI
suggest.dialogDescription: Describe the rule you want in plain language and Manar's AI advisor drafts policy rules from it.
suggest.sideEffectNotice: This isn't a preview: if the advisor returns a usable draft, it immediately creates a new DRAFT policy version. Nothing is published. You'll review and publish the draft separately, exactly like any other version.
suggest.descriptionPlaceholder: Agents may read directory data, but disabling an account requires human approval
suggest.noPoliciesYet: No existing policies to target yet. Describe a new one instead.
suggest.inProgressHint: This can take a while ({seconds}s elapsed).
suggest.success: AI-generated draft policy version created. Review and publish it below.
suggest.unavailableTitle: No AI draft available right now
suggest.unavailableBody: Manar's AI advisor couldn't produce a usable draft for this request. Nothing was created. Try rephrasing your description, or try again shortly.
suggest.aiOff: AI features are switched off for this workspace. Nothing was sent to an external AI provider. A workspace owner can turn on Allow external AI in Settings.
suggest.error: Couldn't reach the AI advisor for this request.

createDialog.title: Create a policy
createDialog.description: Creates the policy and its first DRAFT version. Publish it separately once you're ready.
createDialog.contentHint: A "rules" list. See an existing published policy's YAML view for the exact shape.

detail.name: Name
detail.currentVersionNone: This policy has never been published.
detail.versionsImmutableNote: Every version is permanent once created (Phase 6). Publishing creates no new version, it only flips an existing DRAFT's status.
detail.publishConfirmDescription: Becomes the policy's current PUBLISHED version immediately. This cannot be undone from this console.
detail.publishRoleHint: Publishing requires the Security Admin or Tenant Owner role.

newVersionDialog.title: Create a new draft version
newVersionDialog.description: Either write new rule content, or roll back to an existing version's content exactly.
newVersionDialog.rollbackNone: Don't roll back: use the content above

detail.notFoundBody: No policy with this ID was found in this workspace's policy list.
